message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":null,"missing_evidence":["metrics for error_rate and latency_p95 for checkout service"],"observations":[{"claim":"Checkout service logs show one ERROR, one WARNING, and one INFO message between 10:00 and 10:10.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:2","log:3","summary:ef18cf5ec9016386a23c36156c27c62855ae6fe8264efacc968a8df806b53ce6"]},{"claim":"The ERROR log indicates a request aborted due to 'peer unknown'.","evidence_ids":["log:1"]},{"claim":"The WARNING log indicates no correlated request trace was captured for the aborted request.","evidence_ids":["log:3"]},{"claim":"The INFO log states the checkout process is running but request-path diagnostics are unavailable.","evidence_ids":["log:2"]},{"claim":"No metrics data is available for error rate or latency for the checkout service in the given time range.","evidence_ids":["metrics for error_rate and latency_p95 for checkout service"]},{"claim":"Runbooks suggest distinguishing expected rejections from outages by comparing error counts with successful requests and inspecting authentication and configuration failures separately.","evidence_ids":["runbook:benign-errors","runbook:credentials-configuration"]}],"outcome":"inconclusive","suggested_checks":["Check metrics for error_rate and latency_p95 for the checkout service to quantify failure impact and latency behavior.","Compare counts of failed and successful checkout requests in the same time range to distinguish between isolated errors and systemic issues.","Inspect authentication and configuration logs for the checkout service to identify possible credential or configuration issues causing 'peer unknown' errors.","Verify request tracing and correlation setup to ensure request-path diagnostics are available and functioning.","Review network and peer configuration to understand why the peer is unknown and causing request abortion."]}
